title: Backups: what Bluehost already keeps, read from cPanel onto the Bluehost card
why: The launch plan's B.2 step 1 (research/launch-plan-jan1-2026-11-26.md, gate B: a real backup and restore before launch), from the CEO's brief (2026-11-27): first say what the host already backs up, before our own nightly backup is built. HostBackups reads cPanel's Backup::list_backups and Features::list_features once a day (CPanel::uapi, the token in .env; never from staging, StagingGate) and keeps the reading in SearchIndex's state. The Bluehost card in Modules (Service register) shows one Backups: line under The databases: how many backups Bluehost keeps, from and to which date, about how often going by their dates, and whether JetBackup is on; when none are listed or cPanel couldn't be read, cPanel's own words once with a ↗ to Bluehost's cPanel; on staging, that it isn't read there. Read-only: nothing is backed up or restored, never an alarm (a missed night is B.2's own alarm, coming). Design: approved (the Design reviewer, 2026-11-27, screens at 1280 and 390 in handoffs/b2-backups/screens/). No migration, no new table, no outside call but our own cPanel.
